title: Longest Common Prefix of Two Strings

content.problemStatement:
Given two strings S1 and S2, find the longest common prefix between them.

A prefix means:
Starts from index 0 in both strings.

Return the prefix string itself.

If no common prefix, return "-1".

✔ Example

Input:
flower
flowchart

Output:
flow
